# Glossary

| Term | Meaning as the code uses it | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Ticket | A row in `tickets`: title, slug, priority, status, timestamps | Core entity |
| Slug | URL/display-safe derivation of `title` via `slugify()` | Not guaranteed unique — see `docs/domain/ticket.md` invariants |
| Close | Transition `status: open -> closed`, sets `closed_at`, fires a notification | One-directional; no "reopen" concept exists in code |
| Reset token | Single-use, time-boxed credential proving control of an email address | Not tied to a `users` row — see `docs/domain/user.md` |
| Internal bypass | An undocumented request header (`X-Internal-Bypass: 1`) that skips reset rate-limiting | No code comment or doc explains its intended caller — `docs/open-questions.md#OQ-007` |
| Watchers | The fixed recipient (`watchers@example.internal`) of ticket-close notifications | Hardcoded, not a real distribution list managed in this app — `server.py:76` |
